title: Matrix product verification program
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The program is a membership-query learning program with Boolean output, formed by applying the seeded matrix-product verification procedure to $A,B,C'$ and the seed associated with the one-third small-bias input of dimension $n$.
caveat: The definitions of the one-third small-bias input, its seed, and the seeded verification procedure are not included, so their precise mathematical meanings cannot be stated here.
